name: USB Charger Doctor Multimeter
description: Inline USB diagnostics monitor measuring voltage (3-9V) and current (0-3A) in real time with dual 7-segment LED display.
realWorldAnalogy: Inline USB diagnostics monitor measuring voltage (3-9V) and current (0-3A) in real time with dual 7-segment LED display.

pinout.description: Female USB Type-A Output to Monitored Device

hazards: Do not exceed 9V maximum operating input

wiringGuidance: Plug the USB Doctor directly between your computer USB port and your Arduino board's blue cable. It requires no programming and powers on automatically.
commonMistakes: Trying to upload code through damaged or charge-only USB cables plugged into the doctor.

miniExperiment.title: System Power Consumption Check
miniExperiment.circuit: Plug USB Doctor into laptop, then plug Arduino Uno into USB Doctor.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: The display alternates between ~5.0V voltage and ~0.03A (30mA) operating current.
